title: Let praise loosen your need to grasp
summary: The Lord's power and gifts are sung, not controlled. Praise opens the clenched hand by returning it to wonder.
takeaway: Let praise open the hand that wanted control.
lifeApplication: When your hand tightens around the outcome, name one gift you did not produce and let praise interrupt possession.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord's power and gifts are received through praise, never possessed by control.
source.lifeApplication: When control tightens, answer first with praise instead of mastery.
